name: autocollect-ai
description: Automated B2B invoice collection (AutoCollect AI) — monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @autocollect/api" "npm run dev -w @autocollect/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @autocollect/shared && npm run build -w @autocollect/api && npm run build -w @autocollect/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @autocollect/shared && npm run typecheck -w @autocollect/api && npm run typecheck -w @autocollect/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @autocollect/shared && npm run test -w @autocollect/api
